Title: Cozy Coloring
Description:
Discover a world of vibrant colors and calm creativity with our color-by-number game. Choose beautiful pictures, find the right colors, and fill in each image step by step. It’s a simple and enjoyable way to relax, take your mind off daily worries, and build your own collection of colorful artworks.

The game offers pictures for every mood and age: cute images for kids, beautiful illustrations for adults, animals, flowers, nature, food, patterns, mandalas, and much more. Each coloring page is divided into numbered areas — simply choose a color and tap the matching sections.

The game is perfect for a short break, relaxing after school or work, a peaceful evening, or family time. You don’t need any drawing skills — everyone can create a beautiful finished picture.

There is also a creative mode where you can color each image in your own style!

Color by number, create beautiful images, and enjoy calm creativity anytime.
Instructions:
1. Choose a picture from the collection.
2. Tap a color in the palette.
3. Find the animated areas for that color.
4. Color the zones with one tap.
5. Use hints if you can’t find small details.
6. Complete the picture and view your finished artwork.

Title: Potion Kitchen
Description: Potion Kitchen is a cosy crafting puzzle about running a potion shop at the edge of the market. Guests arrive with orders — one needs a potion of warmth, another a good night's sleep, and some speak in riddles and expect you to work it out. Mix ingredients in the cauldron, brew, and serve before your guest gives up. The recipe book starts empty: all 19 recipes are unlocked by brewing alone, and every one of them can be reasoned out rather than guessed, because the ingredients of a potion share one element.
Instructions:
Serve every guest before their patience runs out.

1. Press "Start shift" — the first guest walks up to the counter.
2. Read the order. A direct request names the potion, a riddle describes its effect; the hints below the order narrow it down.
3. Tap an ingredient on the shelf or drag it into the cauldron. It holds two ingredients, or three once upgraded.
4. Press "Brew" and see what came out. An exact match is "Perfect", but any real potion still sells.
5. Press "Serve": the guest pays in coins and reputation, and a new recipe goes straight into the book.
6. Between shifts, spend coins in the shop on kitchen upgrades.

Mouse, touch or keyboard — Space or Enter to brew and serve, C to empty the cauldron, H for a hint, B for the recipe book, P or Esc to pause, M for sound.

Title: Clean Up Mini Games
Description:
✨ Step into a calm and cozy world where every object finds its perfect place!

🧺 This relaxing mini-game collection lets you sort, clean, pack, arrange, and organize different items — a perfect way to take a peaceful break from your daily routine.

🧩 Complete satisfying levels built around everyday tasks: tidy up cosmetics, arrange furniture, prepare food, pack belongings, and bring messy spaces back to perfect order. Soft visuals and gentle ASMR sounds create a soothing atmosphere that helps you relax while you play.

🌿 Fresh levels are added every week, giving you more ways to enjoy the process, improve your organizing skills, and discover new satisfying challenges.

🧼 Enjoy the calm sounds of cleaning, the pleasure of neat spaces, and the rewarding feeling of putting everything exactly where it belongs. If you love order, cozy tasks, and relaxing mini-games, this is your perfect place to unwind.
Instructions:
🎮 The controls are simple, intuitive, and easy to use for players of all ages.

👉 Tap, hold, and drag items across the screen to move objects, sort them, clean up spaces, and organize everything with just a simple swipe.

💡 Each level includes helpful visual hints, so you can quickly understand what to do, complete the mini-game, and enjoy the relaxing process without confusion.

Title: Amigurumi: Cozy Stitches
Description:
Welcome to your cozy amigurumi workshop! Craft adorable knitted friends with your own hands — from sweet bears and bunnies to fantastical dragons and dinosaurs.

Every toy comes to life in 4 delightful stages:
- Knit the parts by tracing spirals with your finger
- Stuff them with soft filling to perfect plumpness
- Sew on little paws, ears, and tails
- Style the face — eyes, nose, smile, and accessories

Choose your yarn color and type, fulfill customer orders, display your toys in the shop window, level up your crafter skills, and complete your full collection. New quests and bonuses await you every day!
Instructions:
1. Choose a toy from the catalog and pick your yarn color
2. Knitting: trace your finger along the spiral, looping each stitch row by row
3. Stuffing: tap the piece to fill it up — watch the gauge to hit the perfect zone
4. Assembly: press and hold each part until it's sewn onto the body
5. Decorating: place the eyes, nose, and mouth on the face, then add blush or a bow
6. Sell your finished toys, fulfill orders, and save up coins for new materials
7. Level up to unlock new categories, colors, and yarn types

Title: Blind Box Master
Description:
Blind Box Master is a cozy, hand-drawn blind box collection game. Open mystery boxes and discover 100 adorable collectibles across 6 rarities and 5 conditions (Broken to Mint).

Features:
• 4 box tiers, Lucky Charm upgrades & Legendary chases
• 20 cute themed series to collect
• Daily & weekly tasks, achievements, card-flip mini game
• Sell, haggle, synthesize 3 items into higher rarity
• Idle income & showcase your best finds

Tap to play. Desktop & mobile.
Instructions: Tap or click to play. Pick a box on the desk, buy and open it to discover cute collectible items of different rarities and conditions. Sell duplicates for coins, complete daily tasks and achievements, upgrade your luck and idle income, synthesize items, and collect all 100 collectibles. Controlled entirely with mouse clicks or taps.
